title: Compressor Restart Delay
source_reference: 经验改编：压缩机停机后的防频繁启动
requirements: Implement compressor control with a fixed 5 second minimum-off delay. The first demand after power-up may start compressorRun immediately. trip stops the compressor and latches tripLatched; reset clears tripLatched only when trip is FALSE. Every transition of compressorRun from TRUE to FALSE, whether caused by trip or demand becoming FALSE, starts the 5 second delay. A new start requires demand TRUE, tripLatched FALSE and the delay elapsed. Count every FALSE-to-TRUE transition of compressorRun in startCount.

creation_process: 从制冷与气源设备常见防短周期需求提炼固定最小停机时间控制
human_modifications: 固定延时为 5 秒，明确首次启动不等待，并将跳闸和正常需求撤销后的再次启动都纳入防短周期约束
review_process: 分别检查跳闸停机与正常停机的定时起点、复位条件和启动计数边沿
确认题目可用 TON、运行边沿和少量内部状态在单个功能块中实现

plc_rationale: 压缩机停机后延迟重启可减小机械和电气冲击，PLC 定时器与启动计数均为常见功能。

notes: v3 将最小停机延时扩展到所有停机事件。
